message.content: {"decision":"accept","reason":"This arXiv paper presents a new method (HiSentinel) for pre-execution intervention in coding agents, backed by a novel dataset (SWE-Intervene) and empirical results showing up to 14% task completion improvement. It provides concrete evidence about improving coding agent reliability and error prevention, which directly informs what learners can delegate safely and when human intervention is beneficial.","piece_ids":["01"],"strongest_claim":"Lightweight pre-execution intervention via HiSentinel can effectively prevent error propagation and improve the reliability of autonomous coding agents, boosting task completion by up to 14%.","evidence_type":"data","perspective":"research","commercial_incentive":false}
